mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the reactor return was most worthwhile because it showed how reaction water can be reused to reduce the need for new water.

leastWorthwhile.text: Placing hydrogen at the reactor was a straightforward setup step with little to discover on its own.

surprise.text: The reactor’s condensed water made the return of some hydrogen to the water loop tangible.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary; each had a clear role in starting the reactor or returning water.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the expedition uses the fuel and proceeds toward home, though this chapter offered few meaningful choices.
